anchors.cell_block_centre: origin on the centre of the cell block at floor level (interior rooms)
anchors.cell_centre: origin on one cell's centre at floor level (track, tunnels, trestles, riverbeds, ground)
anchors.door_anchor: origin on the room.gd door anchor: 0.4 m in from the room edge = 0.1 m behind the boundary
anchors.free: footprint-centred free prop (any position on the floor)
anchors.lot_line: origin on a cell boundary line at floor level, mid-frontage; buildings stand behind it (-Z), boardwalks / porches / balconies in front of it (+Z, toward the street)

connectors.rule: a door socket takes exactly one wtown.doorway frame (room.gd places it from the room's door data via the arch.door binding)
lot-line pieces share the lot line: boardwalk modules (4 m) and porch / balcony fits of the same span line up in front of a building frontage
boardwalk / platform modules join end to end (x = +-2 m, 1 m in front of the line)
facing track sockets on the same cell-edge midpoint, same gauge
facing tunnel sockets on the same cell edge; clear width 3.0 m
wall lantern origin on the socket, facing the socket direction
canyon walls meet end to end on cell boundaries

grid.note: room plot = cells x 4 m + 0.5 m apron each side; door.position for side cell i = 4*i + 2; lot-line buildings may take doors every 2 m along their frontage
